Bryan Cranston plays the dad, Hal Wilkerson, in Malcolm in the Middle [d3][d6][d8]. As stated directly, "Malcolm's goofy dad, Hal, is played by Bryan Cranston" [d8], and "Hal Wilkerson, played by Bryan Cranston, is married to Lois and is the father of Francis, Reese, Malcolm, Dewey and Jamie" [d6]. Multiple sources confirm this, including Wikipedia, which notes "The ensemble cast includes Jane Kaczmarek and Bryan Cranston as Malcolm's parents, Lois and Hal" [d3]. Cranston is perhaps best known for his later role as Walter White in Breaking Bad [d8], but he played Hal throughout all seven seasons of Malcolm in the Middle (2000–2006) [d7][d10].
